title: AC1021 TABLE border lineweight enum guard correction
scope: Tighten the row-level and cell-level TABLE border lineweight parser/writer paths to the DXF lineweight enum domain.

source.excluded: -4 is internal use only; 26 and arbitrary 16-bit values are not enum members.

behavior: Row-level lineweight parsing marks the TABLE semantically incomplete when the signed DXF value is outside the exact enum.
Cell-level lineweight parsing applies the same enum check while retaining the parsed value for diagnostics.
Row-level raw DWG values are reinterpreted from their 16-bit bit pattern only when the signed result is in the enum; selected-zero and valid sentinels remain representable.
DXF output preflight now applies the enum to row and cell borders, including the AC1018 selected-border path; invalid values fail before destination replacement.

validation.fixturePolicy: Runtime-authored in existing test source; no fixture files were added.
focusedTests: libdxfrw_table_row_alignment_override_parse: ASCII/Binary accepts 0, ByBlock (-2) and 211; missing selected values and out-of-enum row and cell values leave semantic completeness false.

libdxfrw_table_scalar_override_output: ASCII/Binary exact group order and readback with cell and row values; invalid row and cell value 26, invalid visibility, and orphan values preserve the destination; corrected retry succeeds.

limits: This validates the enumerated field domain and codec transport only.
No physical AutoCAD/ODA-produced TABLE order, native rendering or broad producer support is qualified.
followUp: The prior border mapping receipt demonstrated 16-bit transport but used an invalid arbitrary lineweight control value; this receipt supersedes that value-domain implication and narrows the test to valid enum members.
